title: Mom Realizes Cops Know Her Horrifying Secret
description:
Interrogation footage shows Ohio police grilling a mother about the disappearance of her six-year-old son. Brittany Gosney and her boyfriend, James Hamilton, told authorities the young boy simply vanished overnight and may have walked out of the house. Get the full story on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
